name: The Kingdom of Trifectus
description: Three maps. Carve out a kingdom, one rival at a time.

opening.title: The Kingdom of Trifectus
opening.text:
A land of three crowns, and none of them worn well. You arrive with a small company and a long road ahead.

(Placeholder story text.)

ending.title: Trifectus is yours
ending.text:
The last of the three thrones is empty, and the kingdom waits to see what kind of ruler you will be.

(Placeholder story text.)

before.title: Chapter 1: The First Crown
before.text:
Your Opinion Leader sets out with a handful of loyal squads. Somewhere across this valley waits a rival who looks oddly familiar.

(Placeholder story text.)

after.title: The first crown falls
after.text:
Word spreads. Three squads ride in to join your cause, two of them at home on the water and one in the high sky.

(Placeholder story text.)

before.title: Chapter 2: The Sea Between
before.text:
A coastline wraps around a great inland sea. On an island at its heart, the Evil Mr. Bosstoo waits in his fortress.

(Placeholder story text.)

after.title: The fortress falls
after.text:
Mr. Bosstoo's fortress is quiet at last. One crown remains, beyond a river of fire.

(Placeholder story text.)

before.title: Chapter 3: The River of Fire
before.text:
A long valley, cut in two by a river of lava with only three ways across. On the far side, the Beastmaster's castle and his dragons.

(Placeholder story text.)

after.title: The Beastmaster falls
after.text:
The dragons scatter into the mountains, and the castle gates open.

(Placeholder story text.)
